g.text: All modes preserve management and cross-workspace isolation; no new inbound ports or subnet routes are installed.
DNS views grant only the owning workspace's TCP/UDP port 53. Public and private permissions stay separate from UI ingress.
Save settings, then park/unpark to apply them. Parking closes terminal and VS Code views.
Blue arrows: requests. Green: responses / permitted scope. Red dashed: denied attempts.
